quotes.text: I think we have to play a very big role in this, and I think we have to have the controlling role. Again, not to the point where we kill innovation, but at the same time, we also have to guard against potential bad breakouts — models that could go bad.

One of the things that I'm working on right now is to make sure that if you do have a bad actor that breaks into, you know, and starts using your frontier models, that you need to make the government aware of that. There is no requirement right now for anybody to actually make us aware if a bad actor actually has access to some very sophisticated, eventually, weaponry.
